findings.note: The total weight of person plus platform is (50 + 25) kg x 10 m/s^2 = 750 N, not 25 N; 25 kg is the platform mass, not a force. The line does not follow from steps[1] and steps[2].text (which correctly say total pull equals total weight).
With three rope segments each carrying T supporting a 750 N system, T = 750/3 = 250 N, option (b). The solution's own common-mistakes entry uses 750 N for the weight, contradicting this answer.

notes: g = 10 m/s^2 is the only value that lands on an option (g = 9.8 gives 245 N). The three-segment count (two strands at the platform pulley plus the strand at the hand) is correct; only the last line and the final answer are wrong.
